parties: Sambhavnath Infrabuild and Farms Private Limited, Sambhavnath Trust; Lodha Developers Limited
headline: Lodha Developers Limited: Disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations
sum: Sambhavnath Infrabuild and Farms Private Limited and Sambhavnath Trust filed a Regulation 31(4) disclosure with NSE regarding a substantial acquisition of shares in Lodha Developers Limited, triggering mandatory takeover code compliance.
implication: Regulation 31(4) disclosures mark the crossing of a 5% threshold in listed equity and activate the acquirer's obligations under the Takeover Code; the filing does not confirm intent to acquire full control but requires transparency on shareholding patterns and future acquisition plans.
detail: Sambhavnath Infrabuild and Farms Private Limited and Sambhavnath Trust submitted a Regulation 31(4) disclosure to NSE for Lodha Developers Limited, a listed real-estate developer. This disclosure is mandatory when a person (or group of persons acting in concert) acquires shares representing 5% or more of voting capital in a listed company. The filing triggers scrutiny under the Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers (SAST) Regulations and may signal an intention to acquire further stakes or initiate an open offer depending on total shareholding and stated intentions.

framework.ref: SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, Regulation 31(4)
framework.note: Mandatory disclosure by acquirer of shares representing 5% or more of voting capital; central to this filing.

framework.ref: SEBI SAST Regulations, 2011, Regulation 10 (Open Offer Obligation)
framework.note: If combined shareholding of acquirer(s) acting in concert exceeds 25%, an open offer for minimum 26% of remaining shares becomes mandatory.

framework.ref: SEBI SAST Regulations, 2011, Regulation 4 (Acting in Concert)
framework.note: Defines coordinated action between acquirers; determines whether Sambhavnath Infrabuild and Sambhavnath Trust are treated as single acquirer.

framework.ref: Listing Agreement / LODR (SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015
framework.note: Lodha Developers' obligations to promptly inform stock exchange of material developments; governs company-side compliance.
Complementary disclosure and record-keeping provisions for substantial shareholding changes at company level.

framework.ref: SEBI SAST Regulations, 2011, Regulation 16 (Target Company Obligations)
framework.note: Lodha Developers must disclose shareholding pattern and maintain confidentiality until public announcement.

framework.ref: SEBI SAST Regulations, 2011, Regulation 26 (Exemptions & Competing Offers)
framework.note: Carve-outs for creeping acquisition (max 5% p.a.), employee share schemes, and competing offerors.

conditions: Acquisition of 5% or more in voting capital of Lodha Developers Limited by Sambhavnath Infrabuild and Farms Private Limited and/or Sambhavnath Trust
Deemed acting in concert as single acquirer if coordinated
approvals: SEBI Regulation 31(4) disclosure filed with NSE
Possible subsequent NCLT approval if open offer declared at 25% threshold
structure.novel: Filing indicates a potential consolidation move in the listed real-estate sector; structure through a combination of corporate entity (Sambhavnath Infrabuild) and trust vehicle (Sambhavnath Trust) may signal estate/wealth planning or group restructuring.

triggers.note: Mandatory disclosure upon crossing 5% shareholding in listed company.
Open offer obligation triggered if combined holdings exceed 25%.
SEBI's power to regulate takeovers and ensure fair disclosure.
